__comment: Action camera framing. The cut and the release are both instant (blend_out_ms 0). side = blocks to the actor's right, front = blocks along its facing (NEGATIVE = behind the actor, i.e. over-the-shoulder). The CAMERA POSITION does not depend on body size; width_base/width_scale only push the LOOK-AT POINT further ahead so a broad actor does not fill the shot. Scaling the camera offsets by body width is what previously dragged the camera sideways and lost the attacker on a ravager. aim_distance = base look-ahead in blocks. blend_out_ms in milliseconds.
